provider_hint: Gemini API hybrid pipeline: gemini-3.1-flash-lite generator + gemini-3.5-flash reviewer
purpose: Generate curriculum-aligned candidate questions, validate them deterministically, then run a stronger AI quality review before curation. AI output is never published directly to children.

input_schema.subject: Matematika|Bahasa Inggris
input_schema.question_type: choice by default; text only when explicitly required

prompt_rules: Use only the supplied chapter and skill. Do not introduce material from a higher grade.
Use simple, natural Indonesian suitable for the stated elementary grade.
Default to multiple choice with exactly 4 concise options for the MVP.
Every multiple-choice question must have exactly one unambiguous correct answer.
Questions in one batch must vary in structure and should not merely swap numbers in the same sentence.
Every question must include why: explain the reasoning in 1-3 short sentences, not merely repeat the answer.
For mathematics, compute and verify the correct result before creating distractors.
Use terminology consistently: nilai tempat means ratusan/puluhan/satuan; nilai digit means numeric value such as 300, 60, or 7.
Do not explain place value using left/right visual position when mathematical terminology can be used.
Do not mix neighboring skills merely to create variation.
Distractors must reflect plausible child mistakes but must not be misleading or ambiguous.
Return JSON only and follow the schema exactly.

reject_when: question stem too short or too long
skill drift detected by skill-specific guardrail
place-value answer options are not place names
ordering question becomes a number-pattern question
expanded-form question has multiple numerically equivalent correct options
deterministic math result does not match answer index

ai_reviewer.approved_auto_rule: verdict=approved, score >= 85, and no math_error, skill_drift, or ambiguous flag

chapter_candidate_policy.grade3_chapter1_target: minimum 8 approved-auto questions per skill before curation
chapter_candidate_policy.live_bank_rule: Only curated questions may enter the live question bank. approved-auto is a candidate quality status, not direct publication permission.

ux_policy.choice_behavior: Selecting an option immediately locks and checks the answer; do not show a separate Kunci Jawaban button.
ux_policy.after_answer: Show the explanation and one contextual next action only.

math_policy.reason: Mathematical truth and curriculum boundaries should not depend solely on one model generation pass.
